name: Oosawa Keisuke
source:
Keisuke is the quiet, extremely studious boy who usually sits in the corner of a classroom and goes unnoticed. Despite his closed-off appearance, he knows more about what is going on around him then he often lets on. The few people that do associate with him hold a lot of respect for him whether they realize it or not, but those that don't associate with him forget he exists.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/xasy/xasy.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
